author: packs
description: Invoicing (F4-T2): the finance pack's invoice gains kind, payment status, account and contact, buyer VAT number, currency and rate, supply date, number series, the original invoice of a credit or debit note, stored totals, a request key and the e-invoice status; invoice lines with VAT category, rate and amount; recurring invoice schedules. Tax rates are the region pack's region_tax_rate. Privileges to issue, credit and write off, and the Billing Clerk, Accounts Receivable, Finance Manager and Billing Viewer roles. Install after crm, sales, finance and regions.
name: billing-invoicing

definition.description: Issues a draft invoice, giving it its number.
definition.name: Issue Invoices

definition.name: Credit Invoices

definition.description: Writes off an invoice's open balance.
definition.name: Write Off Balances

definition.name: Billing Clerk

definition.description: Issues invoices, raises credit notes and follows balances.
definition.name: Accounts Receivable

definition.description: Everything in billing, including write-offs and tax rates.
definition.name: Finance Manager
